_what: The verification run for the max_iter 3 -> 6 raise (paid-run defect 2). One paid run of `news-to-social` on a local PAID backend (PORT=8097, no SYNTHETIC, /docs -> 404), against the fixture document at commit 8af20c2 - the first paid run of a template whose researcher carries max_iter: 6. It is NOT a second sample of the 2026-09-05 template sweep: the document differs by that one field.
gate_note: ungated by design; BUILDER_ALLOW_GATELESS_GRAPHS=1 on the backend

max_iter_exhaustion.how_known: `research` is the only tool-using node and its max_iter is 6; its node_usage row records call_count 2. Exhaustion requires iterations >= max_iter, so two calls cannot have reached it. The serve log's 'Maximum iterations reached' line is NOT evidence either way here - handle_max_iterations_exceeded prints it only when the agent is verbose, and an authored agent is not.
max_iter_exhaustion.consequence: This run therefore does not exercise the before_llm_call nudge. What it establishes is that the raised cap still runs, still completes, and still costs cents. The nudge itself is proved red-then-green by tests/builder/test_max_iter_nudge.py against a scripted LLM double.

estimate._source: frontend/tests/fixtures/templates/news-to-social.json, which is generated from the same document this run published. The publish response carries no budget block, so it is read from the fixture rather than retyped.
